figures.label: S18
figures.caption: Figure S18 A and B show the local SOC in the 80% Gr electrode after 16 hr of C/16 charging and after 4 hr of C/4 charging, respectively. A large SOC gradient can be observed throughout the electrode thickness at both C-rates, and a more severe gradient is formed at the higher C-rate. Thus, the theoretical capacity of the 80% Gr electrode is not fully utilized even during C/16 charging, which causes the electrode to exhibit smaller accessible capacity than the 40% Gr electrode. These results are consistent with the experimental results for the 80% Gr electrode (Figure 5). It should be noted that the diffusion front is curved due to the presence of inactive electrolyte domains within the electrode.
